summary: Iter28: Tested Numerazione documenti + FatturaPA XML export. 11/13 pytest cases pass; 1 SKIP (no fatturabili DDTs available for testing IVA-default fallback path); 1 FAILURE — CRITICAL BACKEND BUG in PUT /api/company crashes with 500 on the new float field iva_default_pct. Frontend renders correctly: 7 numerazione rows, regime_fiscale + iva_default_pct inputs in Azienda, XML buttons on every fattura row, save button toggles correctly on edit. XML PA generation works end-to-end and is structurally valid.

critical.issue: Returns 500 AttributeError: 'float' object has no attribute 'strip'. Root cause: routers/company.py line 70 — `payload = {k: (v or "").strip() for k, v in body.model_dump(...).items()}` is applied to ALL fields including the new numeric iva_default_pct (float). This breaks the entire company-save flow whenever iva_default_pct is sent as a number (which is what the frontend does). The field is also stored as a stringified value if it ever made it through — type-inconsistent.

_public_view() in routers/company.py returns empty string '' for missing fields via `{k: doc.get(k, '') for k in CompanyIn.model_fields.keys()}` — for the new fields iva_default_pct (float, default 22.0) and regime_fiscale (str, default 'RF01'), it should fall back to the Pydantic default values, not empty string. Otherwise legacy company docs created before this iteration return iva_default_pct='' to the frontend, which then breaks the form (number input) and breaks the billing.py fallback `comp.get('iva_default_pct') or 22` (works due to truthiness but inconsistent).

minor.issue: By design, seq cannot be lowered below current_seq (correctly enforced). Means cleanup tests cannot restore the original counter values — only the suffix is restored. Document this limitation.

Counters (db.counters) and numerazione settings (db.app_settings._id='numerazione') are GLOBAL across tenants by design — acceptable for current single-tenant deployment but should be tenant-scoped in a real multi-tenant scenario.

integration_issues.issue: If user opens Azienda and clicks Save, the PUT /api/company will 500 because the frontend sends iva_default_pct as a number. This blocks all anagrafica updates until the backend bug above is fixed.

action_items: URGENT: Fix /app/backend/routers/company.py upsert_company (line 70). Only apply .strip() to string fields. Suggested fix: `payload = {k: (v.strip() if isinstance(v, str) else v) for k, v in body.model_dump(exclude_unset=False).items()}`

Fix _public_view in /app/backend/routers/company.py to use Pydantic field defaults for missing values (especially iva_default_pct and regime_fiscale), not empty string. Suggested: pull defaults from CompanyIn.model_fields[k].default.
Consider tenant-scoping db.counters and db.app_settings._id='numerazione' for true multi-tenant safety (acceptable for now per problem statement).
critical_code_review_comments: fatturapa.py is clean and modular (352 lines). Good separation: parse_address / progressivo_invio / build_fattura_pa_xml. XML built as a single big format-string — works but a future PR could switch to xml.etree.ElementTree.SubElement for safer construction.

progressivo_invio() correctly extracts NNNNN from PREFIX-YYYY-NNNNN with regex r'-\d{4}-(\d{1,8})' — previous YYYY/NNNNN confusion bug is FIXED. Verified: ProgressivoInvio=00050 != year 2026 for numero FT-2026-00050.
fatturapa.py raises ValueError on missing company P.IVA / cliente identifier; billing.py correctly translates to HTTP 400. Good.
billing.py line 88-90: IVA fallback (body.iva_pct → company.iva_default_pct → 22) is correct.
core.format_numero() correctly reads suffix from app_settings._id='numerazione'.{kind}.suffix. Returns FT-YYYY-NNNNN[suffix]. Good.
company.py upsert_company has the .strip()-on-all-fields BUG (see backend_issues.critical). Same pattern in upload/logo paths uses targeted updates so they're fine.
RBAC on numerazione endpoints (require_roles('admin')) correctly rejects contabilita (403) and unauthenticated (401). Verified.
XML response Content-Type=application/xml + Content-Disposition attachment + filename pattern IT{piva}_NNNNN.xml verified.
Numerazione PUT validates: rejects seq lowering with Italian message containing 'inferiore al corrente', rejects unknown kind with 'non riconosciuto'. Verified.

rca_of_the_issue: PUT /api/company 500 BUG: file /app/backend/routers/company.py line 70 — `payload = {k: (v or "").strip() for k, v in body.model_dump(exclude_unset=False).items()}`. This used to work when CompanyIn fields were all strings. The new field iva_default_pct (float, default 22.0) cannot be .strip()'d → AttributeError. REPRODUCE: send any PUT /api/company body with iva_default_pct as a number (e.g. {"iva_default_pct":10}). FIX: replace with `{k: (v.strip() if isinstance(v, str) else v) for k, v in body.model_dump(exclude_unset=False).items()}`. SECONDARY BUG: _public_view returns '' for missing fields → legacy company docs return iva_default_pct='' which then re-trips the same .strip() bug when the user clicks Save (the frontend form receives '' but probably sends back a number/empty depending on input behaviour).
